info.title: MICROSERVICE-testDev-Create Catalog Freieslb Produce Detail-v1-spec
info.description: The Freieslb Produce Detail Management API facilitates the creation of detailed entries within the Freieslb produce catalog. This endpoint allows users to submit essential information regarding various produce items, ensuring that inventory data is accurate and comprehensive. Ideal for businesses in the agricultural or retail sectors, this API enables inventory management systems or e-commerce platforms to dynamically update produce details. Typical consumers include farmers, distributors, and retailers seeking to enhance their product catalogs.

post.summary: Create or update details for free SLB production.
post.description: This endpoint allows users to create a new detail entry or update an existing one related to the free SLB production process. The request should include the necessary details in the request body. Ensure that all required fields are filled to successfully create or update the resource.

requestBody.description: This request body is used to submit details for the freieslb produce operation. It expects a JSON object that adheres to the defined schema, which outlines the necessary fields and their types required for processing the details effectively.

200.description: The request was processed successfully, and the details are returned.

freieslb_produce_id.description: The unique identifier for the Freieslb produce item.

requestedBy.description: The name or identifier of the person requesting the produce.

quantity.description: The number of produce items requested.

isPriority.description: Indicates if the request is prioritized.

unitPrice.description: The price per unit of the produce.
